value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks partly sunny, with a high around 65 (forecasts run 64 to 67), about 15 degrees cooler than today. Wind is north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, gusting to 17. Rain could move in Tuesday evening, around 30% after 3 p.m., and the chance climbs into the night. Lows drop into the 30s and low 40s. Showers peak late Wednesday, with a high near 49.
